name: Gulf Partnership Project Assistance Fund and North Florida Capacity Fund

funder.name: Partnership for Gulf Coast Land Conservation

administered_by.name: Partnership for Gulf Coast Land Conservation

summary: Grants of up to USD 50,000 that pay land trusts for the due-diligence work behind land and conservation-easement deals (appraisals, title, surveys, baseline studies, closings), plus a North Florida fund for land conservation project staff. Applicants must be Gulf Partnership members.

geography.label: Alabama, Florida, Louisiana, Mississippi and Texas

reporting: A progress report about six months after the award and a final report within 30 days of completion.

steps: Submit the main PAF proposal or North Florida pilot questionnaire
Main PAF committee eligibility and ranking review

eligibility.rule: Main PAF: Be a 501(c)(3) Gulf Partnership member with current dues
Main PAF: Have sent maps of all held easements to the National Conservation Easement Database
Main PAF: Have adopted the Land Trust Alliance standards and practices
Main PAF: Have sought or plan to seek conservation easement or fee title acquisition funding
North Florida pilot: Project must be in the North Florida zone shown on the programme map
North Florida pilot: Show the capacity costs are critical and other acquisition or easement funding does not cover them
North Florida pilot: Have room for an award under the cap of two per quarter and $25,000 per year

documents: Main PAF: Strategic Conservation Vision Report

applicant_types.quote: The Project Assistance Fund is a matching grant program available to land trusts across the Gulf States

geography.quote: The project is located within the Gulf States of Alabama, Florida, Louisiana, Mississippi, or Texas

access.quote: The Gulf Partnership is now accepting PAF Proposals.

window.quote: Request for Proposals can be submitted anytime throughout the year and will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

amount.quote: may receive subawards of up to $50,000 to complete appraisals, appraisal reviews, title exams, environmental and baseline studies, surveys, closings, and other due diligence necessary for conservation activity.

co_finance_required.quote: Applicants are not required to provide match.

reporting.quote: A semi-annual report will be due approximately 6-months after the award, and the completed form will be due 30 days after the completion of the project.

effort.quote: Request for Proposals can be submitted anytime throughout the year and will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
If interested in receiving support, please return the completed questionnaire below or reach out to vance@gulfpartnership.org

Proposals are evaluated by a review committee composed of Gulf Partnership staff, board members, and other conservation organizations for eligibility and compliance with criteria. Projects will be ranked in accordance with alignment for program goals and priorities.

eligibility.quote: They are a 501(c)(3) member of the Gulf Partnership in good standing (annual dues current) and maintain membership through an award performance period.
They have provided geospatial data (i.e., maps) on all the conservation easements they hold to the National Conservation Easement Database.
They have adopted the Land Trust Alliance standards and practices.
Have applied or intend to apply for (CE or fee title) acquisition funding.
The proposal must demonstrate landowner approval and have a clear description of the potential for capital funding for acquisition/easement.
Potential projects must be in the North Florida zone (see map above).
Applicants will need to justify how funding is critical to developing and/or completing projects and is not covered via acquisition or easement source funding.
Applicants can submit multiple proposals but are limited to a maximum of 2 awards per quarter. Organizations are further limited to $25,000 in support annually.

after_award.quote: A semi-annual report will be due approximately 6-months after the award, and the completed form will be due 30 days after the completion of the project.

documents.quote: Budget: Complete the budget table below and include only those budget categories relative to this grant or match.
Map: Attach a map(s) of the project showing the boundary, title of the project, county, state, and any relevant natural features or important adjacent protected areas.
All applicants must attach the Strategic Conservation Vision Report available through https://geoproject.hpc.msstate.edu/SCVTool/.
